summary: Proposes a unified set of Layer 2 abstractions for Layer 3-driven fast handovers. It defines nine kinds of primitives so the network layer can learn about link-layer events and start handovers, since protocol layers are usually designed independently. It is an experimental document from the IP Mobility Optimizations research group.

eli5.summary: Different parts of a phone's networking rarely talk to each other. This paper defines a set of simple messages so the upper layer can know about the link below.

questions: l2 abstractions for l3 fast handover
